panels.title: In one sentence
panels.description:
Customers the model puts at risk (health under 50 or a hard red), the revenue at risk (chance of churn or downsell at the next renewal x the open Salesforce renewal amount, renewals within the horizon), and the model in use: the expert prior until enough outcomes exist, then a model trained on them. AUC: how well it ranked customers out of time (0.5 = chance, 1 = perfect).

**Source:** n360.v_risk_score, n360.v_risk_model, n360.v_risk_outcomes (code/risk/risk_model.py)  
**Filter:** CSM  
**Window:** the newest score

targets.rawSql:
WITH (SELECT any(kind) FROM n360.v_risk_model) AS kind,
             (SELECT countIf(outcome IN ('churned', 'downsold')) FROM n360.v_risk_outcomes) AS events,
             (SELECT any(JSONExtract(backtest, 'methods', 'trained model (probability)', 'auc', 'Nullable(Float64)')) FROM n360.v_risk_model) AS auc
        SELECT if(count() = 0, NULL, concat(
                   concat(toString(countIf(band = 'at risk')), if(countIf(band = 'at risk') = 1, ' customer', ' customers')), ' at risk · ',
                   if(sumIf(revenue_at_risk, revenue_at_risk IS NOT NULL) > 0,
                      concat(if(toUInt64(sumIf(revenue_at_risk, revenue_at_risk IS NOT NULL)) IS NULL, NULL, if(toUInt64(sumIf(revenue_at_risk, revenue_at_risk IS NOT NULL)) >= 1000000, concat(toString(intDiv(toUInt64(sumIf(revenue_at_risk, revenue_at_risk IS NOT NULL)), 1000000)), ',', leftPad(toString(intDiv(toUInt64(sumIf(revenue_at_risk, revenue_at_risk IS NOT NULL)), 1000) % 1000), 3, '0'), ',', leftPad(toString(toUInt64(sumIf(revenue_at_risk, revenue_at_risk IS NOT NULL)) % 1000), 3, '0')), if(toUInt64(sumIf(revenue_at_risk, revenue_at_risk IS NOT NULL)) >= 1000, concat(toString(intDiv(toUInt64(sumIf(revenue_at_risk, revenue_at_risk IS NOT NULL)), 1000)), ',', leftPad(toString(toUInt64(sumIf(revenue_at_risk, revenue_at_risk IS NOT NULL)) % 1000), 3, '0')), toString(toUInt64(sumIf(revenue_at_risk, revenue_at_risk IS NOT NULL)))))), ' revenue at risk in renewals within 180 days · '), ''),
                   'model: ', if(kind = 'trained', 'learning from ', 'expert prior (starts learning at 10 renewals lost; '),
                   concat(toString(events), if(events = 1, ' recorded loss', ' recorded losses')), if(kind = 'trained', '', ' so far)'),
                   if(auc IS NULL, '', concat(' · backtest AUC ', toString(round(auc, 2)))))) AS sentence
        FROM n360.v_risk_score WHERE account IN (SELECT account FROM n360.account WHERE csm_rocketlane IN (${csm:singlequote}))

panels.title: Data
panels.description:
The last day of usage in this load, and the day it was loaded. Amber when the data is more than 2 days old (n360.settings stamp_stale_days): the numbers are the last good night's. Click for Pipeline health.

**Source:** n360.v_freshness (n360.runs: loaded runs only)  
**Filter:** none  
**Window:** the latest load

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat(stamp, if(stale, concat(' · ', toString(days_old), ' days old'), '')) AS stamp FROM n360.v_freshness

panels.title: At risk (model)
panels.description:
Customers with health under 50 or a hard red, each scored date (the score history is filled by "risk_model.py score --as-of all" and each nightly run).

**Source:** n360.risk_scores  
**Filter:** CSM  
**Window:** the last 30 scored dates

targets.rawSql:
WITH nightly AS (SELECT as_of AS night, toUInt64(countIf(band = 'at risk')) AS value FROM n360.risk_scores
        WHERE (as_of, scored_at) IN (SELECT as_of, max(scored_at) FROM n360.risk_scores GROUP BY as_of) AND account IN (SELECT account FROM n360.account WHERE csm_rocketlane IN (${csm:singlequote}))
        GROUP BY night),
             (SELECT max(night) FROM nightly) AS newest,
             (SELECT max(night) FROM nightly WHERE night <= newest - 30) AS ref_30,
             (SELECT min(night) FROM nightly) AS oldest,
             if(ref_30 IS NULL OR ref_30 = toDate(0), if(oldest < newest, oldest, NULL), ref_30) AS ref,
             (SELECT any(value) FROM nightly WHERE night = newest) AS v_now,
             (SELECT any(value) FROM nightly WHERE night = ref) AS v_then
        SELECT toDateTime(night) AS time, value, if(ref IS NULL, 'no earlier night stored', concat(multiIf(v_now > v_then, concat('+', toString(v_now - v_then)), v_now < v_then, concat('−', toString(v_then - v_now)), 'no change'), ' since ', toString(toDayOfMonth(ref)), ' ', formatDateTime(ref, '%b'))) AS change
        FROM nightly WHERE night > newest - 30 ORDER BY time

panels.title: Revenue at risk
panels.description:
Sum over customers renewing within 180 days of: the chance of churn or downsell at that renewal times the open Salesforce renewal amount (its currency; not converted). Customers with no renewal amount add nothing.

**Source:** n360.v_risk_score (n360.sf_opportunity)  
**Filter:** CSM  
**Window:** the newest score

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toUInt64(sumIf(revenue_at_risk, revenue_at_risk IS NOT NULL)) AS `chance x renewal amount, next 180 days`
        FROM n360.v_risk_score WHERE account IN (SELECT account FROM n360.account WHERE csm_rocketlane IN (${csm:singlequote}))

panels.title: Outcomes to learn from
panels.description:
Churns and downsells known so far: closed renewals in Salesforce, closed register entries, outcomes recorded by hand ("risk_model.py outcome"). The same loss can be recorded by two sources; the model counts one outcome per renewal. Under the first stage the model is the expert prior.

**Source:** n360.v_risk_outcomes  
**Filter:** none (every customer)  
**Window:** all time

targets.rawSql:
SELECT countIf(outcome IN ('churned', 'downsold')) AS `churns and downsells recorded (learning starts at 10 renewals lost)`
        FROM n360.v_risk_outcomes

panels.title: Backtest AUC
panels.description:
How well the model ranked customers who later churned or downsold above those who did not, scored out of time (each period by a model trained only on earlier outcomes). Empty until there is enough history: the walk-forward needs 180 days of features and outcomes after them.

**Source:** n360.v_risk_model (risk_model.py train)  
**Filter:** none  
**Window:** the newest training run

targets.rawSql: SELECT JSONExtract(backtest, 'methods', 'trained model (probability)', 'auc', 'Nullable(Float64)') AS `out of time; 0.5 = chance, 1 = perfect` FROM n360.v_risk_model

panels.title: Customers by health and chance at the next renewal
panels.description:
Every customer: band (hard reds, else health under 50 at risk, under 75 watch), health (100 = no risk; the weighted scorecard), the chance of churn or downsell at the next renewal (logistic model; the expert prior until trained), revenue at risk, the three features costing the most health points, hard reds, and coverage (share of the model's weight with data: low coverage = less to go on). Pick a customer above to see every feature below.

**Source:** n360.v_risk_score, n360.v_risk_drivers  
**Filter:** CSM  
**Window:** the newest score

targets.rawSql:
WITH top AS (SELECT account, arrayStringConcat(arraySlice(arrayMap(x -> x.2, arraySort(x -> -x.1,
                                groupArray((points, transform(c.feature, ['pace_gap_pts', 'forecast_end_pct', 'renewal_forecast_risk', 'conv_change_30_pct', 'conv_change_90_pct', 'conv_volatility', 'silent_va_days_30', 'containment_pct', 'containment_change_pts', 'drop_days_30', 'legacy_va_share', 'features_used', 'build_change_pct', 'weeks_config_unchanged', 'days_since_contact', 'days_since_exec', 'open_tickets', 'oldest_open_ticket_days', 'csm_pulse', 'open_churn_risks', 'hard_red_cap'], ['Points behind the term (worst line)', 'Forecast at term end (lowest line)', 'Renewal forecast category (Salesforce)', 'Conversations, last 4 weeks against the 4 before', 'Conversations, last 12 weeks against the 12 before', 'Week-to-week volatility (12 weeks)', 'Days the worst VA was silent when conversations were expected (30 days, settled)', 'Containment (busiest VA with handoff data)', 'Containment change, 30 days against the 30 before', 'Days the worst VA was flagged as a drop (30 days, settled)', 'Share of conversations on VAs below V8', 'Target features used (of 5)', 'Cortex sessions and Explorer questions, 30 days against the 30 before', 'Weeks since any VA\'s configuration changed', 'Days since the last customer contact (Salesforce)', 'Days since the last executive meeting (Salesforce)', 'Open support tickets', 'Age of the oldest open ticket', 'CSM rating (green 0, amber 0.5, red 1)', 'Open churn risks in the register', 'Hard red (health capped at 40)'], c.feature))))), 1, 3), ' · ') AS drivers
                     FROM n360.v_risk_drivers AS c WHERE c.points > 0.5 GROUP BY account)
        SELECT a.display_name AS Customer, s.band AS Band, s.health AS Health, s.probability AS `Chance at renewal`,
               if(s.eligible, 'within 180 days', 'later') AS Renewal, s.days_to_renewal AS `Renews in`,
               s.revenue_at_risk AS `Revenue at risk`, ifNull(t.drivers, '') AS `Biggest drivers`,
               arrayStringConcat(s.hard_reds, ' · ') AS `Hard reds`, s.coverage AS Coverage, s.account AS account
        FROM n360.v_risk_score AS s INNER JOIN n360.account AS a ON a.account = s.account
        LEFT JOIN top AS t ON t.account = s.account
        WHERE s.account IN (SELECT account FROM n360.account WHERE csm_rocketlane IN (${csm:singlequote}))
        ORDER BY indexOf(['at risk', 'watch', 'healthy', 'not enough data', 'not reported', 'churned'], Band), s.probability DESC

panels.title: What costs this customer health
panels.description:
For the customer chosen above: health points each feature costs (its share of the scorecard x its risk; they add up to 100 - health; when a hard red caps health, the points it takes have their own bar).

**Source:** n360.v_risk_drivers  
**Filter:** Customer (one)  
**Window:** the newest score

targets.rawSql:
SELECT transform(feature, ['pace_gap_pts', 'forecast_end_pct', 'renewal_forecast_risk', 'conv_change_30_pct', 'conv_change_90_pct', 'conv_volatility', 'silent_va_days_30', 'containment_pct', 'containment_change_pts', 'drop_days_30', 'legacy_va_share', 'features_used', 'build_change_pct', 'weeks_config_unchanged', 'days_since_contact', 'days_since_exec', 'open_tickets', 'oldest_open_ticket_days', 'csm_pulse', 'open_churn_risks', 'hard_red_cap'], ['Points behind the term (worst line)', 'Forecast at term end (lowest line)', 'Renewal forecast category (Salesforce)', 'Conversations, last 4 weeks against the 4 before', 'Conversations, last 12 weeks against the 12 before', 'Week-to-week volatility (12 weeks)', 'Days the worst VA was silent when conversations were expected (30 days, settled)', 'Containment (busiest VA with handoff data)', 'Containment change, 30 days against the 30 before', 'Days the worst VA was flagged as a drop (30 days, settled)', 'Share of conversations on VAs below V8', 'Target features used (of 5)', 'Cortex sessions and Explorer questions, 30 days against the 30 before', 'Weeks since any VA\'s configuration changed', 'Days since the last customer contact (Salesforce)', 'Days since the last executive meeting (Salesforce)', 'Open support tickets', 'Age of the oldest open ticket', 'CSM rating (green 0, amber 0.5, red 1)', 'Open churn risks in the register', 'Hard red (health capped at 40)'], feature) AS Feature, round(points, 1) AS `Health points lost`
        FROM n360.v_risk_drivers WHERE account IN (${customer:singlequote}) AND points > 0 ORDER BY points DESC

panels.n360MayBeEmpty: no feature costs this customer health

panels.title: Every feature for this customer
panels.description:
Each feature for the chosen customer: its value, its risk (0 at the "good" anchor, 1 at the "bad" one; risk_model.json), health points lost, and its push on the log-odds of churn against an average customer (positive = riskier). "Not reported yet" = the source has nothing: it costs nothing and its weight moves to the rest of its dimension.

**Source:** n360.v_risk_drivers  
**Filter:** Customer (one)  
**Window:** the newest score

targets.rawSql:
SELECT transform(dimension, ['commercial', 'usage', 'quality', 'adoption', 'relationship', 'support', 'voice', 'hard red'], ['Commercial and contract', 'Usage', 'Product quality', 'Adoption and depth', 'Relationship', 'Support', 'CSM view', 'Hard red'], dimension) AS Dimension, transform(feature, ['pace_gap_pts', 'forecast_end_pct', 'renewal_forecast_risk', 'conv_change_30_pct', 'conv_change_90_pct', 'conv_volatility', 'silent_va_days_30', 'containment_pct', 'containment_change_pts', 'drop_days_30', 'legacy_va_share', 'features_used', 'build_change_pct', 'weeks_config_unchanged', 'days_since_contact', 'days_since_exec', 'open_tickets', 'oldest_open_ticket_days', 'csm_pulse', 'open_churn_risks', 'hard_red_cap'], ['Points behind the term (worst line)', 'Forecast at term end (lowest line)', 'Renewal forecast category (Salesforce)', 'Conversations, last 4 weeks against the 4 before', 'Conversations, last 12 weeks against the 12 before', 'Week-to-week volatility (12 weeks)', 'Days the worst VA was silent when conversations were expected (30 days, settled)', 'Containment (busiest VA with handoff data)', 'Containment change, 30 days against the 30 before', 'Days the worst VA was flagged as a drop (30 days, settled)', 'Share of conversations on VAs below V8', 'Target features used (of 5)', 'Cortex sessions and Explorer questions, 30 days against the 30 before', 'Weeks since any VA\'s configuration changed', 'Days since the last customer contact (Salesforce)', 'Days since the last executive meeting (Salesforce)', 'Open support tickets', 'Age of the oldest open ticket', 'CSM rating (green 0, amber 0.5, red 1)', 'Open churn risks in the register', 'Hard red (health capped at 40)'], feature) AS Feature, value AS Value, risk AS Risk, points AS `Points lost`,
               logodds AS `Push on the odds`
        FROM n360.v_risk_drivers WHERE account IN (${customer:singlequote})
        ORDER BY indexOf(['commercial', 'usage', 'quality', 'adoption', 'relationship', 'support', 'voice'], dimension), points DESC

panels.title: Health over time
panels.description:
Each customer's health on every scored date (one line per customer, shades of one colour; customers are not statuses). The dashed line is 50, the at-risk line.

**Source:** n360.risk_scores  
**Filter:** CSM  
**Window:** every scored date

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(s.as_of) AS time, a.display_name AS customer, s.health AS health
        FROM n360.risk_scores AS s INNER JOIN n360.account AS a ON a.account = s.account
        WHERE (s.as_of, s.scored_at) IN (SELECT as_of, max(scored_at) FROM n360.risk_scores GROUP BY as_of) AND s.account IN (SELECT account FROM n360.account WHERE csm_rocketlane IN (${csm:singlequote}))
        ORDER BY time

panels.title: Dimensions for this customer
panels.description:
Health points the chosen customer loses in each dimension (weights in risk_model.json).

**Source:** n360.v_risk_drivers  
**Filter:** Customer (one)  
**Window:** the newest score

targets.rawSql:
SELECT transform(dimension, ['commercial', 'usage', 'quality', 'adoption', 'relationship', 'support', 'voice', 'hard red'], ['Commercial and contract', 'Usage', 'Product quality', 'Adoption and depth', 'Relationship', 'Support', 'CSM view', 'Hard red'], dimension) AS Dimension, round(sum(points), 1) AS `Health points lost`
        FROM n360.v_risk_drivers WHERE account IN (${customer:singlequote}) GROUP BY dimension
        ORDER BY indexOf(['commercial', 'usage', 'quality', 'adoption', 'relationship', 'support', 'voice'], dimension)

panels.title: Backtest: how well each method ranked churn, out of time
panels.description:
Walk-forward backtest of the newest training run: each period scored by a model trained only on outcomes known before it, each renewal judged 150, 90 and 30 days ahead. AUC 0.5 = chance, 1 = perfect; precision = share of the top 10% flagged that churned or downsold; recall = share of all churns and downsells caught in the top 10% (for the rules: of what the rules flag, whatever its share); Brier = calibration error of a probability (lower is better).

**Source:** n360.v_risk_model (risk_model.py train)  
**Filter:** none  
**Window:** the newest training run

targets.rawSql:
SELECT method AS Method, JSONExtract(backtest, 'methods', method, 'auc', 'Nullable(Float64)') AS AUC,
               coalesce(JSONExtract(backtest, 'methods', method, 'top_precision', 'Nullable(Float64)'),
                        JSONExtract(backtest, 'methods', method, 'precision', 'Nullable(Float64)')) AS `Precision, top 10%`,
               coalesce(JSONExtract(backtest, 'methods', method, 'top_recall', 'Nullable(Float64)'),
                        JSONExtract(backtest, 'methods', method, 'recall', 'Nullable(Float64)')) AS `Recall, top 10%`,
               JSONExtract(backtest, 'methods', method, 'brier', 'Nullable(Float64)') AS Brier
        FROM n360.v_risk_model ARRAY JOIN JSONExtractKeys(backtest, 'methods') AS method

defaults.noValue: Not enough history for a backtest yet (180 days of features and outcomes after them)

panels.n360MayBeEmpty: not enough history for a backtest

panels.title: Calibration: predicted against observed
panels.description:
In the backtest, snapshots grouped by predicted chance: mean predicted beside the share that actually churned or downsold. Bars of equal height = a well-calibrated model.

**Source:** n360.v_risk_model  
**Filter:** none  
**Window:** the newest training run

targets.rawSql:
SELECT JSONExtractString(x, 'bin') AS `Predicted chance`, JSONExtractFloat(x, 'predicted') AS `Mean predicted`,
               JSONExtractFloat(x, 'observed') AS Observed
        FROM n360.v_risk_model ARRAY JOIN JSONExtractArrayRaw(backtest, 'reliability') AS x

panels.n360MayBeEmpty: not enough history for a backtest

panels.title: Model weights against the expert prior
panels.description:
Each feature's weight on the log-odds of churn: the expert prior (from the scorecard weights in risk_model.json) and, once outcomes exist, the weight learned from them. Learning comes in stages: first every weight moves together (one slope), then by dimension, then feature by feature; each is pulled toward the prior, and none goes below zero. Features that keep no history (Salesforce forecast category, open tickets) keep their prior weight, rescaled by the learned slope.

**Source:** code/risk/risk_model.json, n360.v_risk_model  
**Filter:** none  
**Window:** the newest training run

targets.rawSql:
SELECT transform(p.f, ['pace_gap_pts', 'forecast_end_pct', 'renewal_forecast_risk', 'conv_change_30_pct', 'conv_change_90_pct', 'conv_volatility', 'silent_va_days_30', 'containment_pct', 'containment_change_pts', 'drop_days_30', 'legacy_va_share', 'features_used', 'build_change_pct', 'weeks_config_unchanged', 'days_since_contact', 'days_since_exec', 'open_tickets', 'oldest_open_ticket_days', 'csm_pulse', 'open_churn_risks', 'hard_red_cap'], ['Points behind the term (worst line)', 'Forecast at term end (lowest line)', 'Renewal forecast category (Salesforce)', 'Conversations, last 4 weeks against the 4 before', 'Conversations, last 12 weeks against the 12 before', 'Week-to-week volatility (12 weeks)', 'Days the worst VA was silent when conversations were expected (30 days, settled)', 'Containment (busiest VA with handoff data)', 'Containment change, 30 days against the 30 before', 'Days the worst VA was flagged as a drop (30 days, settled)', 'Share of conversations on VAs below V8', 'Target features used (of 5)', 'Cortex sessions and Explorer questions, 30 days against the 30 before', 'Weeks since any VA\'s configuration changed', 'Days since the last customer contact (Salesforce)', 'Days since the last executive meeting (Salesforce)', 'Open support tickets', 'Age of the oldest open ticket', 'CSM rating (green 0, amber 0.5, red 1)', 'Open churn risks in the register', 'Hard red (health capped at 40)'], p.f) AS Feature, p.w AS `Expert prior`,
               if(m.kind = 'trained', JSONExtract(m.model, 'coef', p.f, 'Nullable(Float64)'), NULL) AS `Trained`
        FROM (SELECT f, w FROM values('f String, w Float64', ('pace_gap_pts', 0.1463), ('forecast_end_pct', 0.4389), ('renewal_forecast_risk', 0.3901), ('conv_change_30_pct', 0.3121), ('conv_change_90_pct', 0.1560), ('conv_volatility', 0.1170), ('silent_va_days_30', 0.1951), ('containment_pct', 0.2048), ('containment_change_pts', 0.2341), ('drop_days_30', 0.1463), ('legacy_va_share', 0.1463), ('features_used', 0.1463), ('build_change_pct', 0.1463), ('weeks_config_unchanged', 0.1463), ('days_since_contact', 0.3511), ('days_since_exec', 0.2341), ('open_tickets', 0.0975), ('oldest_open_ticket_days', 0.0975), ('csm_pulse', 0.1170), ('open_churn_risks', 0.0780))) AS p
        CROSS JOIN (SELECT any(kind) AS kind, any(model) AS model FROM n360.v_risk_model) AS m
        ORDER BY p.w DESC
